description: This file defines the ApiList class which manages a collection of packages related to Android API members, including functionalities for package management, warning/error tracking, and debugging info.

classes.name: ApiList
classes.description: A class that holds a list of API members, including classes, fields, and methods. It manages packages and tracks warnings and errors.

methods.name: ApiList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ApiList with a debug string.

methods.name: getDebugString
methods.description: Returns the debug string associated with this ApiList.

methods.name: getOrCreatePackage
methods.description: Retrieves a package by name, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getPackageIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all known packages.
